character: Garmisch-Partenkirchen in Bavaria has two ski areas run by the Bayerische Zugspitzbahn: Garmisch-Classic (Hausberg, Kreuzeck, Alpspitze) above the town, home of the Kandahar World Cup downhill, and the Zugspitze glacier ski area on Germany's highest mountain, reached by rack railway and cable car. The two areas are not linked on skis.
learning: Reference note: ski schools operate in Garmisch-Partenkirchen, and the Zugspitze glacier has easy runs; confirm beginner areas and lessons.
